details.judge_reason: Text is sharply rendered, high contrast, and easily readable against the marble background.

product.reason: Reference shows a bracelet-style charm with threaded core hole; ad depicts it converted into a necklace pendant, altering product identity/form.

observations.shape: Same tree-of-life openwork circular motif, consistent design and proportions as reference charm
observations.colour: Sterling silver tone matches reference; consistent material appearance
observations.logo: No visible logo/brand marking in either image
observations.label_text: Price and 'LIMITED EDITION' text added as ad overlay, not on product itself; no garbled text
observations.parts_and_count: Product shown as pendant on chain necklace, not a bracelet charm with core hole as in reference
observations.presence: Product itself is shown, worn as pendant, not just pictured on packaging

season_fit.reason: Snowy outdoor scene, warm indoor lighting, frosted window view suggest cold winter atmosphere consistent with Vienna winters.

market_fit.reason: Cozy wood-paneled interior, warm lamps, and snowy European street scene feel plausible for Vienna without contradicting the setting.

no_cliche.reason: No landmarks, flags, or forced national symbols; décor and jewelry focus on mood and product rather than stereotypes.
